newsitem.title: CHINA: China television king sees profits soar in '96.
newsitem.headline: China television king sees profits soar in '96.

text.p: Sichuan Changhong Electric Appliances Co Ltd, China's biggest television manufacturer, expects its pre-tax profits to climb to more than 2.0 billion yuan this year, company officials said on Thursday.
That marked an increase in pre-tax profits of at least 400 million yuan compared with last year, officials said.
Changhong's output soared after it shocked domestic competitors by cutting retail prices of its colour televisions by between eight and 18 percent in late March.
Sales revenue this year was expected to rise four billion yuan compared with 1995 to 12 billion yuan, the China Business Daily said.
Its colour television output was expected to exceed 4.6 million units, the newspaper said.
In 1995, Changhong produced 3.052 million colour and 2.08 million black and white televisions with total turnover of 6.764 billion yuan.
Changhong reported net profits of 1.15 billion yuan in 1995, the best results in terms of net profit increase among China's domestic A share companies.
